title: batch.consumption_recorded.v1
description: Emitted once per closed production batch by manufacturing-service (src/production/production.service.ts) and consumed by ledger-service to post a Dr Work-in-Progress / Cr Raw Material Inventory journal entry, at ACTUAL consumption cost. See docs/SDD.md §3.C.

event_id.description: Random per publish — idempotency for this posting is guaranteed by production_batches.client_event_id at the outer closeProductionBatch() call, not by this ID being deterministic.

consumption_value.description: Sum of actual_qty * unit_cost (from the recipe_version's ingredient cost snapshot) across all consumption lines.
